status_of_seasons.current_already_looked_at: 2026/27 up to the data snapshot below (NOT a holdout)

decision_rule: Primary metric: log loss of the exact score (log score of the whole matrix). A: Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 (pooled 2023/24+2024/25, all variants vs P+R), better in both selection seasons, not worse by point in 2025/26 and 2026/27, no market group significantly worse on the selection seasons (95 % CI above 0 for totals, BTTS, handicaps, 1X2) and Main ROI not significantly worse (pooled selection CI not below 0). B: better in both selection seasons and the pooled 95 % CI below 0 without the Holm correction, or A-level evidence failing 2025/26 / 2026/27. C: everything else. Added after the first run (BP+R): a family whose fitted parameter sits in every fold at the value where it equals production (BP l3 = 0, NB r at the bound) is C — the remaining difference is numerical (tail renormalised instead of folded into 10 goals).

H1_HY+R.forward_criterion: On matches played after the commit of this file (settled, all leagues of the system), the paired bootstrap 95 % CI (by match, 2000 resamples, seed 20261109) of mean log loss of the exact score (variant - production P+R) lies below 0, evaluated once at >= 3000 settled matches (or at the end of season 2026/27 if fewer: then 'inconclusive' unless the CI is below 0); AND, as a guard, the paired 95 % CI of Main ROI difference at real pre-match prices does not lie entirely below 0.
H1_HY+R.decision_now: B. A only if the forward criterion holds; a better probability alone does not justify a change that lowers Main ROI.
